name: Pairwise Message Routing Distraction
description: Frame the requirement of finding the minimal connected subgraph (Steiner tree) as a requirement to successfully route messages between all pairs of primary facilities. Because the problem explicitly asks to support O(t^2) individual message paths, models are heavily biased toward simulating the pairwise routing or using tree difference arrays to count traffic. Since t can be up to 200,000, any O(t^2) approach will Time Out, defeating models that fail to recognize the global Steiner tree equivalence.
